ABOUT US

Stockyard Refacing

Stockyard Refacing is a cabinet refacing company located in Waco, Texas that specializes in updating the appearance of kitchen and bathroom cabinets by applying a new veneer or finish to the existing cabinet boxes, and replacing the doors and drawer fronts with new ones. Cabinet refacing is a cost-effective and sustainable way to give your kitchen or bathroom a fresh new look without the expense and hassle of a full renovation.
